mechanism: Selegiline (MAOI at higher doses) combined with haloperidol (dopamine antagonist) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, extrapyramidal side effects, and serotonin syndrome through inhibition of monoamine metabolism and CNS dopaminergic/serotonergic interactions.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use selegiline at lowest dose (≤5mg daily) with careful monitoring of blood pressure, mental status, and extrapyramidal symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower MAOI interaction risk.
